summary: Iteration 36: Branch/Division Exclusion Toggle Feature Testing. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Toggle UI works, but Dashboard does NOT auto-refresh when toggle is clicked - requires manual Refresh button click.

ui_bugs.issue: Dashboard does NOT auto-refresh when branch toggle is clicked. useEffect on line 38 has [autoRefresh, selectedFY] but missing 'excludeBranches' dependency
ui_bugs.workaround: User must click Refresh button manually after toggling

issues: Minor React hydration warning: span inside option element (cosmetic, doesn't affect functionality)

Backend branch filtering works correctly via X-Exclude-Branches header in sales.py, inventory.py, customers.py

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 36 tested the Branch/Division Exclusion Toggle feature. Backend APIs all work correctly - X-Exclude-Branches header properly filters branch parties from sales, inventory, and customer data. The branch party 'ASA Autotech India Pvt Ltd Raipur DEPOT' is correctly detected and filtered. CRITICAL BUG: Dashboard.js useEffect on line 38 is missing 'excludeBranches' in its dependency array, so the dashboard doesn't auto-refresh when the toggle is clicked. Users must click the Refresh button manually. Fix: Change line 38 from [autoRefresh, selectedFY] to [autoRefresh, selectedFY, excludeBranches]. Toggle state correctly persists via localStorage and is preserved across page navigation.
